title: Performance of a Large Language Model for Predicting Clinical and Radiographic Outcomes in Knee Osteoarthritis: Single-Center Prospective Observational Study.
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can extract information from unstructured clinical text, but it remains unclear whether their ability to assess current status translates into reliable predictions of longitudinal outcomes. This study aimed to evaluate DeepSeek's ability to assess baseline clinical and radiographic status in knee osteoarthritis (KOA), its performance in predicting 6-month outcomes, and its interrun reproducibility. title: Effect of Social Determinants of Health on Pediatric Traumatic Brain Injury Phenotypes: Retrospective Cohort Analysis.
abstract: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) in children disrupts cognitive, physical, and emotional functioning, posing a significant public health challenge in the United States. Recovery after pediatric TBI is nonlinear, influenced not only by fluctuations in progress but also by social determinants of health (SDoH), including sociodemographic features and health care access. title: Motivations, Experiences, and Perceived Consequences of Repeated Mental Health-Related Content Creation on Social Media: Reflexive Thematic Analysis of Chinese Young People.
abstract: Mental health-related content has been increasingly visible on Chinese social media among young people, including the expression of negative affect and personal experiences of mental health issues, treatment, and recovery. Such content could reach a wide audience and influence their understanding of and responses to mental health issues. title: The Use of Electronic Information Resources by General Practice Trainees During Consultations in Australia: Qualitative Analysis of Interview and Screen-Recording Data.
abstract: The proliferation of electronic clinical information resources has transformed how evidence is accessed during primary care consultations, particularly in community settings where clinicians must rapidly access reliable information at the point of care (POC). For general practice trainees, who are still developing clinical expertise and information-seeking skills, how these digital resources are used during real-time decision-making remains poorly understood. title: Bow hunter's syndrome presenting with embolism in an older patient treated with C1-2 posterior fixation using intraoperative digital subtraction angiography: illustrative case.
abstract: Bow hunter's syndrome (BHS) is a rare cause of vertebrobasilar insufficiency (VBI) or artery-to-artery embolism resulting from vertebral artery (VA) occlusion during head rotation due to cervical instability. VBI predominates, whereas embolic BHS is rare. A 77-year-old man presented with recurrent posterior circulation ischemic strokes. title: Intracranial EWSR1::CREM fusion sarcoma presenting as a paraneoplastic inflammatory syndrome: illustrative case.
abstract: Intracranial mesenchymal tumors with EWSR1::CREM fusion are rare neoplasms that can mimic common dural-based lesions like meningiomas and may present with atypical systemic features driven by tumor-associated inflammatory signaling. The authors report the case of a 31-year-old female who initially presented with unexplained anemia, systemic inflammatory symptoms, and difficulties with conception. title: The placental transfer of nirmatrelvir using the ex vivo human placental perfusion model.
abstract: Nirmatrelvir is an effective therapeutic option for COVID-19 infection and is often administered after symptom onset in pregnant individuals, but few data are available on the associated fetal exposure. The placental perfusion model evaluates maternal-fetal drug transfer across the human placenta and thus can determine fetal drug exposure. title: Guidelines on sexual health for women of reproductive age in Singapore.
journal: Annals of the Academy of Medicine, Singapore
abstract: Sexual health is integral to women's overall well-being, yet sexual dysfunction among women of reproductive age remains under-recognised and undertreated. These guidelines provide evidencebased recommendations for the screening, assessment, education, and optimisation of sexual health in this population. title: Lecanemab in Singapore: Appropriate use recommendations for early Alzheimer's disease.
journal: Annals of the Academy of Medicine, Singapore
abstract: Lecanemab, a monoclonal antibody targeting β-amyloid oligomers, protofibrils, and insoluble fibrils, has been approved for Alzheimer's disease (AD) treatment in Singapore, based on the phase 3 Clarity AD study. title: Digital Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Reduces Intensification of Antihyperglycemic Therapy in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes.
abstract: We evaluated the effect of cognitive behavioral therapy delivered via a novel digital therapeutic application (app) on antihyperglycemic medication use in adults with type 2 diabetes. Trial participants were randomized to receive access to BT-001 or a control app for 180 days.
